I am currently using a VBA script in Module 1, but I have to manually update the VBA script whenever a new ID/Name pair is added. from copy import copy

# 1) INSPECT
# --------------------

print("Workbook sheets:", wb.sheetnames)
for ws in wb.worksheets:
    # real non-empty dimensions
    max_r = 0
    max_c = 0
    for row in ws.iter_rows():
        for cell in row:
            if cell.value is not None:
                max_r = max(max_r, cell.row)
                max_c = max(max_c, cell.column)
    print(f"Sheet {ws.title!r}: real non-empty size = {max_r} rows x {max_c} cols")
    preview_rows = min(max_r, 6)
    preview_cols = min(max_c, 12)
    for r in range(1, preview_rows + 1):
        print(ws.title, r, [ws.cell(r, c).value for c in range(1, preview_cols + 1)])

open_ws = wb["Open"]
prod_ws = wb["Productivity"]

# Build the ID -> Name lookup dynamically from Productivity columns A and B.
# Do not assume row count; scan all used rows in those columns.
id_to_name = {}
for r in range(1, prod_ws.max_row + 1):
    mud_id = prod_ws.cell(r, 1).value
    name = prod_ws.cell(r, 2).value
    if mud_id is None or name is None:
        continue
    # Skip obvious header row if present, without relying on its row number.
    if isinstance(mud_id, str) and isinstance(name, str):
        if mud_id.strip().lower() in {"mud id", "id"} and name.strip().lower() == "name":
            continue
    # Store both the original key and its string form so text/numeric-like IDs match robustly.
    id_to_name[mud_id] = name
    id_to_name[str(mud_id)] = name

print("Lookup entries found:", len(id_to_name))
print("Original Open!C2:C23:", [open_ws[f"C{r}"].value for r in range(2, 24)])

# --------------------
# 2) SOLVE
# --------------------
# Only modify the allowed answer range: 'Open'!C2:C23.
for r in range(2, 24):
    cell = open_ws.cell(r, 3)  # column C
    value = cell.value
    replacement = None
    if value in id_to_name:
        replacement = id_to_name[value]
    elif value is not None and str(value) in id_to_name:
        replacement = id_to_name[str(value)]
    if replacement is not None:
        cell.value = replacement

output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)

# --------------------
# 3) VERIFY
# --------------------
out_wb = load_workbook(output_path, data_only=False)

        if mud_id.strip().lower() in {"mud id", "id"} and name.strip().lower() == "name":
            continue
    check_lookup[mud_id] = name
    check_lookup[str(mud_id)] = name

checked = False

    original = in_open.cell(r, 3).value
    expected = check_lookup.get(original, check_lookup.get(str(original) if original is not None else None, original))
    actual = out_ws.cell(r, 3).value
    if original in check_lookup or (original is not None and str(original) in check_lookup):
        print(f"Hand check Open!C{r}: input ID {original!r} -> expected name {expected!r}; saved {actual!r}")
        assert actual == expected
        checked = True
        break
if not checked:
